title: Fifty Fifty’s ‘After-School Exorcism Club,’ The Boyz’s ‘Wi-Fi Love in the Palace’ and NCT’s ‘Wind Up: The Movie’ Score New Asia Sales for Finecut
content:
ByNaman Ramachandran

South Korean sales companyFinecuthas landed new territorial deals for two K-pop idol-fronted theatrical titles, “After-School Exorcism Club: Girls’ Night” and “Wi-Fi Love in the Palace,” while also adding fresh markets for the previously sold “Wind Up: The Movie.”

“After-School Exorcism Club: Girls’ Night” has gone to Indonesia (Catchplay+), Singapore (Shaw Organisation) and Taiwan (Cola Films). “Wi-Fi Love in the Palace” has been picked up by Japan (KDDI Corporation), Indonesia (Catchplay+) and Taiwan (Cola Films). The former premiered at the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival ahead of its domestic theatrical run and opened in Singapore cinemas in mid-August.

“Wind Up: The Movie,” starring NCT members Jeno and Jaemin, has picked up additional sales to Hong Kong and Macao through Emperor Cinemas. That adds to previously announced deals covering the CIS (Best Cinema), Inflight (Bofrato), Japan (KDDI Corporation), Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia (Purple Plan), Taiwan (Caichang International) and Thailand (Sahamongkolfilm International).

“After-School Exorcism Club: Girls’ Night” follows five students at the same high school as they look into a spirit possessing their campus and race to stop it before it seizes full control. K-pop groupFifty Fifty‘s Keena, Chanelle Moon, Yewon, Hana and Athena each play one of the students. Fifty Fifty broke through internationally with its 2023 single “Cupid” before coming back with a different lineup in 2024. Jung Zoo directs.

“Wi-Fi Love in the Palace” is based on the Kakao Page webtoon “Love and Wi-Fi in the Palace.” It follows a webtoon artist chasing his next hit and a palace maid working her way up within the royal court, their stories crossing via a mysterious cabinet that bridges the present and a point 200 years back.The Boyz‘s Younghoon stars alongside Luda (“The Woman Who Swallowed the Sun”) and Kim Dong-jun (“Korea-Khitan War”). Chang Tae-you (“Bon Appétit, Your Majesty,” “My Love From the Star”) oversees the project as chief creative director, while Sa Seok-choon, who co-directed “Bon Appétit, Your Majesty,” directs.

The three titles all stem from Kitz, the global K-pop-focused content platform operated by TakeOne Company, and were developed under the company’s broader push into multi-format IP. Another Finecut title from the Kitz slate, “Reapers on Duty,” follows two grim reapers – a rule-abiding rookie played by Monsta X’s Hyungwon and a rule-breaking veteran played by Lee Min-ki – who get caught up in a storyline centered on extending a person’s life.

The titles will be presented at Broadcast Worldwide (BCWW) and the ongoingToronto Film Festivalmarket, alongside other Finecut properties: animated feature “Long Long Night,” selected for the Toronto Centrepiece; webtoon adaptation “Guardians of the Video Game,” drawn from source material with 345 million views; noir action film “Tristes Tropiques,” directed by Park Hoon-jung; and “Dora,” directed by July Jung and selected for Cannes Directors’ Fortnight and the Busan International Film Festival’sGala Presentation.
title_zh: Fifty Fifty的《放學後驅魔俱樂部》(After-School Exorcism Club)、The Boyz的《宮中的Wi-Fi愛情》(Wi-Fi Love in the Palace)以及NCT的《風起：電影版》(Wind Up: The Movie) 為Finecut獲得新的亞洲銷售。
content_zh:
由南曼·拉馬昌德(Naman Ramachandran)報導

南韓銷售公司Finecut最近為兩部以K-pop偶像為主的劇場電影《放學後驅魔俱樂部：女孩之夜》(After-School Exorcism Club: Girls’ Night)和《宮中的Wi-Fi戀愛》(Wi-Fi Love in the Palace)簽下了新的區域交易，同時也為之前已售出的《上弦月：電影版》(Wind Up: The Movie)增加了新的市場。

《放學後驅魔俱樂部：女孩之夜》已在印尼(Catchplay+)、新加坡(Shaw Organisation)和台灣(Cola Films)獲得發行權。《宮中的Wi-Fi戀愛》則被日本(KDDI Corporation)、印尼(Catchplay+)和台灣(Cola Films)選中。前者在其國內上映前於富川國際奇幻電影節首映，並於八月中旬在新加坡電影院上映。

《上弦月：電影版》由NCT成員任燦(Jeno)和嘉敏(Jaemin)主演，透過皇帝影業在香港和澳門獲得了額外的銷售。這增加了之前已宣布的交易，包括獨聯體(Best Cinema)、航空公司(Bofrato)、日本(KDDI Corporation)、新加坡、馬來西亞和印尼(Purple Plan)、台灣(Caichang International)和泰國(Sahamongkolfilm International)。

《放學後驅魔俱樂部：女孩之夜》講述了五名在同一所高中的學生，他們調查一個附身於校園的靈魂，並急於在靈魂完全控制之前阻止它。K-pop團體Fifty Fifty的Keena、Chanelle Moon、Yewon、Hana和Athena各自飾演其中一名學生。Fifty Fifty以2023年的單曲《丘比特》(Cupid)在國際上取得突破，並計劃在2024年以不同陣容回歸。導演為鄭周(Jung Zoo)。

《宮中的Wi-Fi戀愛》改編自Kakao Page的網路漫畫《宮中的愛與Wi-Fi》(Love and Wi-Fi in the Palace)。故事講述了一名追尋下一部熱門作品的網路漫畫家和一名在皇宮內努力上升的宮女，他們的故事透過一個神秘的櫃子交錯，這個櫃子連接著現在和200年前的時空。男孩團體The Boyz的Younghoon與盧達(Luda)（《吞日之女》(The Woman Who Swallowed the Sun)）和金東俊(Kim Dong-jun)（《高麗-契丹之戰》(Korea-Khitan War)）共同主演。張泰佑(Chang Tae-you)擔任首席創意總監，負責該項目，而共同導演《皇上，您好》(Bon Appétit, Your Majesty)的沙錫俊(Sa Seok-choon)則擔任導演。

這三部作品均源自Kitz，這是一個由TakeOne Company運營的全球K-pop內容平台，並在公司的更廣泛推動下開發多格式的知識產權。Finecut的另一部來自Kitz名單的作品《執行中的死神》(Reapers on Duty)講述了兩位死神的故事——一位由Monsta X的炫煥(Hyungwon)飾演的守規矩新手和一位由李敏基(Lee Min-ki)飾演的破規老手，他們卷入了一個圍繞延長人類生命的故事情節中。

這些片名將在全球廣播(Broadcast Worldwide, BCWW)和正在進行的多倫多電影節市場中展示，還有其他Finecut的作品：動畫長片《漫漫長夜》(Long Long Night)，入選多倫多中心展映；網絡漫畫改編的《電子遊戲守護者》(Guardians of the Video Game)，其原始素材擁有3.45億次觀看；由朴勳鄭(Park Hoon-jung)執導的黑色動作片《悲傷的熱帶》(Tristes Tropiques)；以及由鄭朱莉(July Jung)執導的《朵拉》(Dora)，該片入選坎城導演雙週和釜山國際電影節的盛典放映。
